verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a built-in MCP Client that connects external MCP servers and discovers their tools, prompts, and resources so you can invoke, query, or test them directly in the app. Tool use appears to be user-driven invocation and testing rather than an in-product AI agent calling tools on its own. missing for 10: details on supported transports/auth and configuration depth, evidence of autonomous AI use of the connected tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Use Insomnia to connect external Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers to access AI-ready tools, prompts, and resources.
The Insomnia MCP Client discovers these elements, which enables you to invoke, query, or test them directly in the app.
